intent: An order's coverage window is the date range running from its order date to its delivery date.
notes: Computation authoring exercising the DateRange CONSTRUCTOR (built 2026-06-08). Gold verified (RuleValidator.check over a DraftComputation; the kernel accepts CoverageWindow = DateRange(OrderDate, DeliveryDate)). The order fixture's CoverageWindow is a date-range field; OrderDate/DeliveryDate are dates. Measures whether a cold agent discovers the computation-spec shape (via `schema computation add`) AND reaches for the DateRange constructor over attempts to build a range from a comparison. The constructor is also legal in ==/!= conditions, outside this task. GOLD POLARITY (gold is UNGUARDED, intentionally): the kernel does NOT evaluate a DateRange operation when an operand is empty — it computes no value and clears any stale value (verified at runtime, KERNEL-FINDINGS §2 supplement; locked by adapter.laws.DateRangeComputationLawsTest). So a candidate adding `commonPrecondition AllFieldsFilled(OrderDate, DeliveryDate)` is EQUIVALENT (the guard is redundant) — the judge prompt carries this fact.
